cases.disposition_reason: holla --scenario activities-multi --color truecolor --motion reduced opens at 120×40 with the activity tabs already open. Ctrl+G opens the Activities dialog. The wait is Enter Switch, because the Here footer already contains Ctrl+G Activities. The dialog lists frontend dev (running · child), api dev, api tests (succeeded · project), logs · api worker scheduler, and btm (detached · host). ~/work/batch and Retry frontend dev are absent. Esc returns to Search actions. Alt+3 shows api tests · succeeded · 2 s · exit 0, aliases_beat_everything, 128 tests run: 128 passed, and started by Run api tests. VITE v6.3.1 and EADDRINUSE are absent. Esc returns to Here, and aliases_beat_everything is gone from that screen. Live activities open Quit holla. Stay starts focused. Right moves to Stop and quit. Enter exits 0.

cases.disposition_reason: activities-multi draws running, cancelling, stopped, succeeded, and detached. frontend dev · running shows port 5173, url http://localhost:5173/, pid 7731, and VITE v6.3.1. api dev · running shows port 8080, pid 9120, Compiling api v0.9.2, and listening on 0.0.0.0:8080. api tests · succeeded · 2 s · exit 0 keeps aliases_beat_everything. btm · detached shows btm 0.11.1 and started by Open system monitor. s on the running frontend sends SIGTERM: the header becomes frontend dev · cancelling, with Stopping frontend dev · SIGTERM sent · output kept and stop requested by holla · SIGTERM to the process group, and VITE v6.3.1 stays. The header then becomes frontend dev · stopped, with exit 130 and terminated (SIGTERM) · process group reaped, and the VITE line and url stay. Queued is not on these screens. Activity::new sets the state to Running (src/bin/holla/domain/activity.rs). World::start_batch assigns Queued only to a later sequential member (src/bin/holla/sim/world.rs). activities_multi, launch_failure, and executor do not call start_batch. The clock runs when motion is not Paused (src/bin/holla/domain/fixtures.rs), and World::tick returns before advancing activities only while the clock is stopped (src/bin/holla/sim/world.rs), so a live activity keeps changing the frame under reduced motion. The checkpoint is the finished launch-failure activity frontend dev · failed · 1 s · exit 1, with listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::5173 and the sticky status ! frontend dev failed · exit 1. launch_failure starts task:frontend-dev-fail, which ends at exit 1. The same frame is captured at 120×40 and then at 80×24, and the terminal returns to 120×40. The footer draws r Restart, and the follow-up Retry frontend dev is on screen. Both were left unused. KeyCode::Char('r') calls Activity::restart (src/bin/holla/screens/activity.rs). Activity::restart clears that activity's output and keeps its id (src/bin/holla/domain/activity.rs). The retry follow-up sends Go::Restart into App::run_derived, which restarts the same id (src/bin/holla/app.rs). The separate row is Run tests again, recorded on the activities-multi scenario. Open the failing test is drawn. FOLLOW_UPS does not include that label, so follow_up_supported leaves it inactive (src/bin/holla/screens/activity.rs). Find, copy, follow, and the log-stream digit filter are driven on the activities-multi scenario.
cases.action_sequence: Reach each implemented activity state, including spawn failure, nonzero exit, and restart. Filter, find, select, copy, and follow output.
cases.expected_results: The visible status and exit status belong to that activity. Another activity's output does not change.
cases.forbidden_effects: Restart rewrites the failed run's identity.

Alt+1 shows frontend dev · running, VITE v6.3.1, and pid 7731, and the test line is absent. Alt+3 restores aliases_beat_everything and exit 0, and VITE v6.3.1 and pid 7731 are absent. / aliases_beat shows find “aliases_beat” · 1 of 1. Esc closes the find bar. Ctrl+A then y shows Copied $ cargo nextest run, and aliases_beat_everything remains on the api tests screen. f shows Following the tail. f again shows Follow paused · End resumes. The test line stays. Alt+1 still shows VITE v6.3.1 and http://localhost:5173/, and the test line and 128 tests run: 128 passed are absent. Alt+4 shows logs · api worker scheduler · running, worker ready · queue=orders concurrency=4, and GET /health 200. Digit 1 hides the api stream: GET /health 200 leaves and the worker line stays. Alt+3 still shows the original test line. Tab focuses Run tests again. Enter starts a separate activity test · succeeded · 0 s · exit 0 with $ mise run test and [mise] test finished. Alt+3 still shows api tests · succeeded · 2 s · exit 0, aliases_beat_everything, and 128 tests run: 128 passed, and [mise] test finished is absent. Ctrl+G lists succeeded · project for api tests and succeeded · here for the new test. ~/work/batch, Retry frontend dev, and EADDRINUSE are absent. r and Retry frontend dev were not pressed. Both call Activity::restart on the same id (src/bin/holla/screens/activity.rs, src/bin/holla/domain/activity.rs, src/bin/holla/app.rs). Run tests again calls Go::Run for the mise test task and starts a new activity (src/bin/holla/screens/activity.rs). Open the failing test stays inactive because FOLLOW_UPS omits that label. The quit guard confirms Stop and quit and exits 0.
